description: Submit an agent usage report for an MCP server. Reports are aggregated and influence registry trust scores. Call this after using an MCP server so the registry can track real-world reliability. Supports both a simple outcome report and a structured scoring report (criterion + component_score).

criterion.description: Specific reliability criterion being scored (enables structured component scoring)

environment.description: Environment the server was used in

errors.description: Array of error strings encountered during tool use

evidenceRef.description: Trace ID, log URL, or other reference supporting this report

serverUrl.description: The MCP server endpoint URL that was used

severity.description: Severity of the worst issue encountered

taskDescription.description: Brief description of what the task was

toolsUsed.description: List of tool names that were called

turnsRequired.description: Number of turns to complete the task

name: report_server
